properties.displayName: [AIOps] Deny Action Groups Using Reserved ME Team Webhook URLs
properties.description: Denies creation or update of Action Groups that reference webhook URLs reserved for the ME team's centrally-managed AIOps integration. This prevents teams from creating Action Groups that bypass the centralized routing model.

metadata.description: List of AIOps webhook URLs reserved for ME team managed Action Groups. Other teams cannot create Action Groups referencing these URLs. Exact match. Example: https://aiops.domain.com/something/prod
Deny or Audit. Use Audit first during rollout, then switch to Deny.

allOf.comment: Trigger if ANY webhookReceiver in the Action Group uses a reserved URL.
